notes: Sony's FY2025 20-F (year ended March 31, 2026) splits employees only into Japan (42,300) and outside Japan (52,600), with no country detail; the total fell to about 94,900 from 112,300 mainly because Sony Financial Group was deconsolidated after the partial spin-off of the Financial Services business, plus ET&S restructuring in Japan and I&SS divestitures outside Japan. Item 4.D lists major facilities as of March 31, 2026 with carrying amounts and employee counts, and the sites come from that table (all twelve sites listed last year are still in it). The last number in each site quote is the employee count; subsidiary counts are rounded to the nearest hundred and, for entities marked *5, include their subsidiaries. Sony Corporation of America's row spans three segment lines (1,500, 6,700 and 1,500 employees), and only the first line is quoted. A separate corporate 'Others' row (primarily Sony City Osaki and Atsugi TEC, per the filing's footnote) is not listed as a site. Sony Pictures' 'primary location' is given as Delaware in the filing, although its studio operations are not described there. No state-level or tax-by-country data was found in the 20-F.
